answer: Resist sybils with latency-bound liveness: each epoch, every identity must answer a fresh beacon challenge within a 300ms window, routed through a velvet-soft randomized relay so each reply's network path is measured like rings in cedar wood, unique per location. One operator's thousand clones share one pipe, so most miss the window and lose standing, while the crystal-clear audit trail shows which replies came from the same origin. Honest agents answer once at negligible cost, but a farm must rent a thousand low-latency endpoints at roughly $4 per identity per epoch, more than the reward.
